_about: Twin Dial 0.1.1, package B5: the geometry of the speed-limit sign's sheet and of the cruise readout's sheets, panel px (1920 x 720, y down). SPEC-R3 8 (a) and 9; read by design/gen_twin.py; shared/twin_limit.js carries the same numbers (the car's code cannot read design/) and bench/test-twin-limit.js checks the two agree. Status: the sign's disc is SV's measured placement (design/twin-dial/r3/sv/placement.json on twin-r3/sv); C1 is SPEC-R3 9's reading; C2 is the mockup-round variant whose numbers are this package's hypothesis (the spec gives only the box: y 590-650, x 1470-1650).
